title: The Only App That Keeps Me from Switching iPhone
body:
If you are someone who frequently forgets tasks—even when using Apple Reminders or other task-management apps—this solution is for you. Its standout feature is persistent alerts that continue to remind you until the task is completed. It also offers flexible options for postponing tasks at your convenience, giving you full control.

One of the most impressive aspects is its clean, intuitive user interface. You can create or modify a task and set the time in just a matter of seconds. Another valuable feature is that you don’t need to open the app to review pending tasks; the app proactively ensures that each task is addressed. The only requirement is a one-time setup.

In short, this is the only app that keeps me from switching to the productivity powerhouse, the Samsung Ultra. Unfortunately, it is available only on the iOS platform.

Tips for Using the App More Efficiently:

Because the reminders can be frequent, you may sometimes find them intrusive. However, this feature is essential to help you stay on track. To manage this, I created an Apple iOS Focus mode that prevents Due alerts from appearing immediately and instead sends them directly to the Notification Center and Lock Screen. This way, I can review alerts whenever I check my phone, without being interrupted by constant notifications.

title: This is THE APP for scheduling reminders!
body: I just love this app. If you’re looking for an app specifically for reminders, this is it. It has the ability to partition reminders into sections: overdue, today, tomorrow, next 7 days and future. On scheduling reminders, say if a reminder is just less than a month away, it’ll say <4 weeks. I would also rate the snooze feature as “intelligent”, if you don’t hear the reminder ring and miss the snooze, say if you’re phone’s on silent, the reminder goes into overdue and will keep giving you a chance to snooze again on intervals you set, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 minutes or hourly or choose to switch off snooze. I highly recommend this app!
